notes:
Notes from discovery/demo/negotiation:
- Interested in Hosted API first -> validated product fit via sandbox. Then asked for Dedicated to achieve predictable unit economics and VPC isolation.
- Use-case priority: 1) Chat-based support agent (p95 < 120ms target), 2) personalization scoring for recommendations (embedding + reranking), 3) search relevance tuning.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high. Wants guaranteed baseline commit (12-month) with option to ramp to higher commit at month 6. Quote request: baseline commit = 10M tokens/month (Q1), ramp to 30M tokens/month by month 6.
- Burst pattern: spikes up to ~2x baseline for 20-45 minutes/day (marketing campaigns + product launches). Asking for burst capacity (instant) with defined overage rate / daily cap.
- Legal & security: must pass data residency question for EU customers (selective routing), SOC2 required, KMS integration for key management, audit logs for model inputs/outputs (30d).
- Quote reactions: AE provided initial Dedicated tier pricing; procurement pushed back on minimum commit and overage %. Asked for 12m ramp schedule and a cap on monthly overage at 25% of commit for first 3 months.
- SE notes: prefer quantized Mistral/Llama variants for cost; want per-route routing policy so low-cost model used for non-critical queries. SE suggests onboarding plan: 6-week Dedicated migration checklist, canary rollout -> A/B traffic split -> fallbacks to Hosted API.
- Customer quote (paraphrase): "We need predictable monthly cost and predictable latency — we can't have surprise token bills during holiday launches."
- Decision process: procurement + infra + security + product. Procurement lead: Mark S. (Mark.S@cedarwell.ai). Security lead: Priya N.
- Timeline: target contract signing by 2024-12. If pricing gap closed, expect legal 2-week cycle, infra kickoff in Jan.
